programmes.d: A hired gunman arrives in town to kill a man Lucas has hated for years.
A drought has forced local cowhands to seek work on a railroad construction project.
Lucas gives blood to save a dying man.
Mark finding a murder victim's body sets Lucas, Artemis and Marshal on a search for the killer.
A band of Indians kidnaps Mark and disappears into the hills.
An infamous train robber dies and leaves his ill-gotten wealth to Lucas.
A man dies after the bank forecloses the mortgage on his ranch; his son blames the banker for this.
A rancher is shot by an unknown killer, and his daughter's lover is jailed.
A group of outlaws devises a plan to get rid of Lucas so that they can take over North Fork.
After Lucas kills a mountain man in a brawl, his father arrives to break his other boys out of jail.
Newly arrived gunslinger Al Walker throws a mammoth party at the saloon.
Lucas accuses a reporter's misleading articles of causing an innocent man's death.
Lucas and Mark lie to protect a family.
Lucas becomes involved in the family troubles of the hotel clerk.
Fallen ill, a couple seeks shelter.
Lucas and Mark are stranded in the middle of a desert with very little food or water.
Stagecoach robbers hold Mark hostage.
Outlaws threaten to kill Micah.
Lucas tries to do a good deed for the town drunk but it backfires.
Lucas and Mark find themselves caring for a 6-month-old baby.
Lucas becomes involved in a battle between an aspiring writer and a cocky, bragging trail boss.
Mark runs away from home when he thinks that Lucas believes he's lying.
A hunter tries to force a fight.
When a man arrives to marry the town spinster, two brothers who want her land try to threaten him.
Two tough private detectives appear in North Fork looking for a boy.
Lucas is drawn to a young widow passing through town on her way to claim an inheritance.
After a stablehand kills a notorious gunslinger, he is baffled by the hostility of the townspeople.
Lucas and Mark help a friend who has been cheated in a horse trade.
An elderly couple moves to North Fork to hide the fact that they are the parents of a killer.
Lucas finds that a girl and her brother are plotting the murder of their abusive stepfather.
A condemned killer being transported by train murders a marshal and takes Mark hostage.
Mark discovers that the new preacher and his wife are impostors planning a robbery.
Lucas and Marshal Torrance get into trouble with the Army when they try to help a wounded soldier.
Mark contracts typhoid fever and has a vision of his dead mother.
An old friend of Lucas returns to town in the company of a shady gambler.
Several men are vying for a prosperous rancher's daughter's affections.
Lucas receives a series of mysterious threatening notes from an ex-convict with a grudge.
Andy Moon and his young son take shelter at the McCain ranch.
A bank-robbing gunman decides to hide out at the McCain ranch.
A sharecropper enters his colt in a horse race hoping to win enough money to buy back his farm.
A convict is released from prison and returns home to North Fork.
Lucas helps an old friend, a federal agent, infiltrate a gang of robbers.
Lucas finds himself involved in murder when he gallantly steps to the aid of a beautiful woman.
An ex-convict is blamed for a brutal crime despite his claims of rehabilitation.
Lucas is out for vengeance when Mark is used as a pawn in a bank robbery scheme.
Lucas shoots a horse thief who turns out to be a member of the Boyle clan; Ma Boyle is after him.
